publication.title: MCXC-II: Second release of the Meta-Catalogue of X-ray detected Clusters of galaxies

sources.citation: Sadibekova et al. (2024), MCXC-II, A&A 688 A187; CDS J/A+A/688/A187, byte columns defined by https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/ftp/J/A+A/688/A187/ReadMe

derivation.position: CDS RAdeg/DEdeg J2000 coordinates; spectroscopic z integrated in the publication flat Lambda-CDM cosmology to comoving distance. ICRF transport at J2000 catalogue precision, no proper-motion evolution.
derivation.aperture: Published R500 proper Mpc converted to comoving metres using (1+z). An X-ray-derived overdensity aperture, not a cluster edge. A projected outline is an annotation; no luminous gas or member distribution is supplied.
derivation.camera: 1.5 times comoving R500 is a navigation framing radius, not a measured size.
derivation.limitations: Comoving positions derived from spectroscopic redshifts using the MCXC-II flat cosmology (H0=70 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m=0.3). No peculiar-velocity correction or redshift-independent local distance is claimed; this matters especially for nearby Virgo and Fornax.

oracle: The sibling application was used only to discover the seven desired names and compare interaction. Its coordinates, distances, radii, and binary tables are not inputs.
